description: This file defines a data structure for gateway setup payload and provides functions for decoding such payloads from raw strings, supporting JSON and Base64 encoding formats.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a raw string into a GatewaySetupPayload, trying JSON first, then Base64 encoded JSON.

methods.name: decodeFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a GatewaySetupPayload.

methods.name: decodeBase64Payload
methods.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded string, normalizing input and padding before decoding.
